correctness.rationale: Every trigram occurs at exactly one of the 27 linear starts. A nine-element hitting set must cover exactly three starts per mark without overlap, forcing marks 2,5,…,26. Hitting all such windows hits every occurrence of every longer factor, so the only further tests are the three letters and nine digrams. I independently enumerated all 2·6^8 local exit orders of the Euler graph with 000 fixed first. Every complete tour uniquely determines and is reproduced by its orders. All ten-subsets were filtered by explicit bit-mask coverage of the 27 starts, yielding 275, and each of the 27 linear cuts per tour was tested directly, without the source's residue shortcut. The seven disjoint chunks in /workspace/audit-evidence/2/census.py and totals.txt give 373248 cycles, 8274096 cuts of size nine, 1803600 of size ten and none unresolved; the cycle histogram is 0:1632, 9:19968, 18:155568, 27:196080. Direct all-factor checking confirms the displayed witness's ten marks; all its cuts fail nine. A second independent symbol-recursion run agreed. The source C++ was inspected but not executed, and no claim for other orders follows.
